name: Weighted Pull-Up
cues: Pronated grip just outside shoulders; full hang to chin clear of bar; control the descent.
instructions: Hang a dip belt with plates and take a pronated grip just outside shoulder width.
Start from a full dead hang with shoulders active and legs quiet.
Pull until your chin clears the bar without kipping.
Lower under control until the elbows are fully straight.
Reset the hang briefly before the next rep.

name: Weighted Dip
cues: Slight forward lean; elbows track about 45°; shoulders below elbows at the bottom; lock out without shrugging.
instructions: Load a dip belt and support yourself on parallel bars with arms locked.
Lean slightly forward and lower until the shoulders sit below the elbows.
Keep the elbows tracking about 45 degrees from the torso.
Drive up to a full lockout without shrugging the shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top before the next descent.

name: Weighted Muscle-Up
cues: False grip or deep pull; drive hard into the transition; keep the bar or rings close; finish with a full dip lockout.
instructions: Load a dip belt and set a false grip or deep overhand grip on the bar or rings.
Pull aggressively until the chest rises above the hands.
Drive the hips and wrists through the transition while keeping the implement close.
Finish with a controlled dip lockout at the top.
Lower with control through the dip and pull phases back to a hang.

name: Back Squat
cues: Brace before you move; hips back and down; hip crease below parallel; mid-foot pressure; drive knees out.
instructions: Set the bar on the upper back, unrack, and step out to a stable stance.
Brace the core hard before you break at the hips and knees.
Sit the hips back and down until the hip crease is below parallel.
Keep mid-foot pressure and drive the knees out as you stand.
Lock the hips and knees at the top without losing the brace.

name: Chin-Up
cues: Supinated grip; pull elbows to the ribs; stay quiet in the hips; brief pause at the top.
instructions: Take a shoulder-width supinated grip and hang fully straight.
Pull the elbows toward the ribs until the chin clears the bar.
Keep the hips quiet and avoid swinging.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower to a full hang.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
cues: Palms facing each other; full hang to chest toward the handles; wrists stacked under the bar.
instructions: Grip parallel handles with palms facing each other and hang fully.
Pull until the chest rises toward the handles.
Keep the wrists stacked under the hands throughout the pull.
Lower under control to a full hang before the next rep.

name: Inverted Row
cues: Body rigid from heels to head; pull chest to the bar; squeeze shoulder blades; step feet farther to load more.
instructions: Set a bar at about waist height and hang underneath with a straight body line.
Pull the chest to the bar while keeping heels to head rigid.
Squeeze the shoulder blades at the top.
Lower until the arms are straight, then repeat.
Step the feet farther forward to increase difficulty.

name: Barbell Row
cues: Hinge to about 45°; pull the bar to the lower ribs; no bounce; keep the low back neutral.
instructions: Hinge the hips until the torso is about 45 degrees with a neutral low back.
Pull the bar to the lower ribs without bouncing it off the floor or thighs.
Squeeze the mid-back at the top of each rep.
Lower the bar under control and reset the hinge brace.

name: Face Pull
cues: Pull to face or ears; turn the hands out at the finish; keep the load light enough for clean reps.
instructions: Set a cable at upper-chest height with a rope attachment.
Pull the rope toward the face or ears with elbows high.
Externally rotate so the hands finish near the ears.
Return slowly with control and keep the ribs down.

name: Dead Hang
cues: Active hang: slight scap depression; neck long and relaxed; hold for time with quiet legs.
instructions: Grip the bar and hang with the arms fully straight.
Depress the scapulae slightly to keep an active hang.
Keep the neck long and the legs quiet.
Hold for the target time, then step down under control.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
cues: Arms stay straight; depress and retract the scapulae only; pause at the top; no elbow bend.
instructions: Hang from the bar with locked elbows.
Depress and retract the scapulae without bending the elbows.
Pause briefly at the top of the scapular movement.
Relax back to a full passive hang and repeat.

name: Ring Dip
cues: Turn rings out at the top; own the instability; full range each rep; stop if a shoulder pinches.
instructions: Support yourself on the rings with arms locked and rings turned out.
Lower until the shoulders are at or below elbow height.
Keep the rings close to the body and the core braced.
Press back to a full lockout with rings turned out at the top.
Stop the set if either shoulder pinches.

name: Front Squat
cues: Elbows high; torso upright; full depth; breathe and brace before each rep.
instructions: Set the bar across the front delts with elbows high and chest up.
Brace, then sit straight down while keeping the torso upright.
Reach full depth with heels planted.
Drive up through the mid-foot to a full standing lockout.

name: Romanian Deadlift
cues: Soft knees; hinge until you feel a hamstring stretch; bar close to the legs; spine neutral.
instructions: Stand tall with the bar against the thighs and a soft knee bend.
Hinge at the hips while keeping the bar close to the legs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch with a neutral spine.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall without hyperextending the low back.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Tilt the pelvis under; raise the legs without swing; lower under control.
instructions: Hang from the bar with an active shoulder position.
Tilt the pelvis under and raise the legs without swinging.
Lift until the legs reach at least parallel, higher if controlled.
Lower under control and reset before the next rep.

name: Band Curl
cues: Elbows pinned at the sides; full stretch to full squeeze; smooth tempo, no heave.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold the handles with elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl through a full range from stretch to peak squeeze.
Lower slowly without letting the elbows drift forward.
Keep a smooth tempo and avoid heaving the torso.

name: Band Triceps Extension
cues: Pin the elbows; extend fully each rep; use a band light enough for clean lockouts.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead or high and grip the ends with elbows bent.
Pin the elbows in place and extend the elbows fully.
Squeeze the triceps at lockout without shrugging.
Return to the start with control and repeat.

name: Pike Push-Up
cues: Hips high; head travels toward the floor between the hands; own full depth before adding load.
instructions: Set up in a pike with hips high and hands shoulder-width.
Bend the elbows so the head travels toward the floor between the hands.
Lower as deep as shoulder comfort allows.
Press back to a locked-out pike position.

name: Overhead Press
cues: Brace glutes and core; bar path close to the face; lock out overhead without leaning back.
instructions: Set the bar at the front rack with a grip just outside the shoulders.
Brace the glutes and core, then press the bar close past the face.
Lock out overhead with the biceps near the ears and ribs down.
Lower to the shoulders under control and reset the brace.

name: Push-Up
cues: Body in one line; chest to the floor; elbows about 45°; full lockout without sagging hips.
instructions: Set the hands under the shoulders and brace the body in one rigid line.
Lower until the chest nearly touches the floor with elbows about 45 degrees.
Press to a full lockout without letting the hips sag.
Reset the brace and repeat.

name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
cues: Grip outside shoulders; initiate with the lats; chin over bar; full hang each rep.
instructions: Take a pronated grip clearly outside shoulder width.
Start from a full hang and initiate the pull with the lats.
Pull until the chin clears the bar without kipping.
Lower slowly to a full hang before the next rep.

name: Pull-Up Negative
cues: Jump or step to the top; lower for 3–5 seconds; full hang finish; no bounce.
instructions: Jump or step to a chin-over-bar position.
Lower for three to five seconds through the full range.
Finish in a controlled dead hang.
Reset and repeat without bouncing out of the bottom.

name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Pull the bar to the upper chest; lean back slightly; control the return; no torso heave.
instructions: Sit tall and grip the bar slightly wider than the shoulders.
Pull the bar to the upper chest with a slight lean.
Squeeze the lats at the bottom without shrugging.
Return the bar under control until the arms are straight.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
cues: Full hang to chin clear; match the machine assistance to clean reps; no half reps.
instructions: Set the assistance so you can complete clean full-range reps.
Start from a full hang with a pronated or neutral grip.
Pull until the chin clears the handles.
Lower under control to full elbow extension each rep.

name: Seated Cable Row
cues: Tall torso; pull to the lower ribs; squeeze scapulae; avoid yanking with the low back.
instructions: Sit tall with the feet braced and arms stretched forward.
Pull the handle to the lower ribs while keeping the torso stable.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the finish.
Extend the arms under control without rounding the upper back.

name: Dumbbell Row
cues: Hinge or bench support; pull elbow past the hip; no torso twist; full stretch at the bottom.
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench with the other foot on the floor.
Pull the dumbbell toward the hip with the elbow close to the body.
Pause briefly at the top without twisting the torso.
Lower to a full stretch and finish all reps before switching sides.

name: Chest-Supported Row
cues: Chest glued to the pad; pull elbows back; squeeze hard; no momentum.
instructions: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging straight down.
Pull the elbows back until the shoulder blades squeeze together.
Keep the chest glued to the pad throughout.
Lower the weights under control to a full stretch.

name: Band Pull-Apart
cues: Arms long; pull the band to the chest line; squeeze scapulae; smooth tempo.
instructions: Hold a light band at shoulder height with straight arms.
Pull the hands apart until the band reaches the chest line.
Squeeze the rear delts and scapulae at the finish.
Return slowly without letting the shoulders shrug up.

name: Diamond Push-Up
cues: Hands under the sternum; elbows tight; chest to hands; rigid plank line.
instructions: Place the hands under the sternum with thumbs and index fingers close.
Keep a rigid plank and lower the chest toward the hands.
Keep the elbows close to the torso on the way down.
Press to full lockout without letting the hips sag.

name: Ring Push-Up
cues: Rings tight to the body; turn out at the top; full depth; own the instability.
instructions: Set the rings just above the floor and brace in a plank on the rings.
Lower with the rings close to the body until the chest passes the hands.
Press up and turn the rings out at the lockout.
Keep the core tight to control the instability each rep.

name: Bench Dip
cues: Hands on the edge; lower until elbows near 90°; stay close to the bench; no shoulder dump.
instructions: Place the hands on a bench edge behind you with feet on the floor or another bench.
Lower until the elbows are near 90 degrees while staying close to the bench.
Keep the shoulders from dumping forward at the bottom.
Press back to a full arm lockout.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cues: Hands just inside shoulders; elbows tuck; bar to lower chest; lock out hard.
instructions: Lie on the bench and set a grip just inside shoulder width.
Unrack and lower the bar to the lower chest with elbows tucked.
Press to a hard lockout without flaring the elbows wide.
Keep the wrists stacked and the shoulder blades pinched throughout.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Wrists stacked; lower to a stretch; press up and in; no bounced reps.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above the chest and wrists stacked.
Lower the bells until you feel a chest stretch at the bottom.
Press up and slightly inward to lockout.
Control every rep without bouncing off the chest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Bench 30–45°; lower to the upper chest line; press smoothly; keep ribs down.
instructions: Set an incline between 30 and 45 degrees and lie back with dumbbells.
Lower the bells to the upper-chest line with control.
Press to lockout without flaring the ribs.
Keep a steady tempo and full range each rep.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
cues: Brace hard; press in a slight arc; lock out overhead; no excessive lean.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at shoulder height and brace the core.
Press the bells overhead in a slight arc to lockout.
Keep the ribs down and avoid leaning back.
Lower to the shoulders under control before the next rep.

name: Lateral Raise
cues: Soft elbows; raise to just below shoulder height; lead with the elbows; no swing.
instructions: Stand tall with light dumbbells at the sides and a soft elbow bend.
Raise the arms out to the sides until just below shoulder height.
Lead with the elbows and keep the wrists neutral.
Lower slowly without swinging the torso.

name: Reverse Fly
cues: Hinge or chest support; soft elbows; open the arms wide; squeeze rear delts.
instructions: Hinge at the hips or lie chest-supported with light dumbbells hanging down.
Open the arms wide with soft elbows until you feel the rear delts work.
Squeeze briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower under control and repeat.

name: Rear Delt Fly Machine
cues: Chest on the pad; arms long; open against the pads; pause and return slow.
instructions: Sit with the chest against the pad and grip the handles or pads.
Open the arms back until the rear delts are fully contracted.
Pause briefly without using momentum.
Return slowly to the start position.

name: Barbell Curl
cues: Elbows fixed; full stretch to full squeeze; no hip drive; control the eccentric.
instructions: Stand with a shoulder-width underhand grip and elbows at the sides.
Curl the bar to a full squeeze without swinging the hips.
Lower through a full stretch under control.
Keep the elbows fixed throughout the set.

name: Hammer Curl
cues: Neutral grip; elbows pinned; full range; no torso lean.
instructions: Hold dumbbells with a neutral grip and elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl the bells up without rotating the wrists.
Squeeze at the top, then lower to a full stretch.
Keep the torso still and avoid leaning back.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
cues: Elbows glued to the sides; full lockout; control the return; ribs down.
instructions: Stand at a high cable with a straight bar or rope and elbows pinned in.
Extend the elbows to a full lockout while keeping the ribs down.
Squeeze the triceps at the bottom.
Return until the forearms are just above parallel and repeat.

name: Skull Crusher
cues: Upper arms still; lower to the forehead or behind; extend fully; elbows track.
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold a barbell or EZ bar above the shoulders.
Keep the upper arms still and bend the elbows to lower the bar toward the forehead.
Extend the elbows fully without flaring them wide.
Control every eccentric and reset the lockout between reps if needed.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
cues: Elbows high; stretch the long head; extend fully; avoid flaring.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell overhead with both hands and elbows pointing up.
Lower the weight behind the head until you feel a long-head stretch.
Extend the elbows fully without flaring them out.
Keep the ribs down and the upper arms mostly still.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Rear foot elevated; front shin vertical-ish; descend straight down; own the balance.
instructions: Stand in a split stance with the rear foot elevated on a bench.
Hold dumbbells at the sides and keep the torso mostly upright.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel with the front shin mostly vertical.
Drive through the front foot to stand and finish all reps before switching sides.

name: Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench; chin tucked; drive through the heels; pause at full hip extension.
instructions: Set the upper back on a bench with the bar over the hips and feet flat.
Brace, tuck the chin, and drive through the heels to full hip extension.
Pause and squeeze the glutes at the top without overarching the low back.
Lower the hips under control and repeat.

name: Walking Lunge
cues: Long controlled steps; front knee tracks over mid-foot; torso tall; no slam into the floor.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at the sides and step forward into a long lunge.
Lower until the rear knee nearly touches the floor with a tall torso.
Drive through the front foot and step into the next lunge.
Keep the front knee tracking over the mid-foot each step.

name: Goblet Squat
cues: Bell at the chest; elbows inside the knees; sit deep; stay upright.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at the chest with elbows pointed down.
Sit the hips down and back while keeping the torso upright.
Descend as deep as mobility allows with heels flat.
Drive up to a full stand without letting the knees cave in.

name: Leg Press
cues: Feet mid-platform; full range without peeling the low back; controlled press; no lockout slam.
instructions: Sit in the sled with feet mid-platform about shoulder-width apart.
Lower the sled until the knees bend deeply without the low back peeling off the pad.
Press through the mid-foot to near lockout without slamming.
Keep the knees tracking over the toes throughout.

name: Leg Curl
cues: Hips glued down; curl to a full squeeze; control the eccentric; no hip hike.
instructions: Set the pad on the lower calves and lock the hips into the machine.
Curl the heels toward the glutes to a full squeeze.
Lower under control without letting the hips hike.
Repeat with a smooth tempo.

name: Leg Extension
cues: Pad on the shins; extend fully; pause; lower slow; no jerking.
instructions: Sit with the pad on the lower shins and the back supported.
Extend the knees fully and pause briefly at the top.
Lower the weight slowly to the start position.
Avoid jerking or bouncing out of the bottom.

name: Calf Raise
cues: Full stretch at the bottom; rise onto the toes; pause; slow lower.
instructions: Set the shoulders or hands under the pads with the balls of the feet on the step.
Drop the heels into a full stretch at the bottom.
Rise onto the toes and pause at the top.
Lower slowly through the full range.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cues: Brace hard; roll out only as far as you can keep a hollow; pull back without folding the hips.
instructions: Kneel with the ab wheel under the shoulders and brace into a hollow shape.
Roll forward only as far as you can keep the ribs down and hips from folding.
Pull the wheel back to the start using the abs and lats.
Reset the brace before each rollout.

name: Hollow Hold
cues: Lower back glued down; ribs tucked; arms and legs long; hold for time.
instructions: Lie on your back and press the lower back into the floor.
Lift the shoulders and legs into a long hollow shape.
Keep the ribs tucked and arms reaching overhead or by the sides.
Hold for the target time without letting the low back arch.

name: Plank
cues: Elbows under shoulders; ribs down; glutes on; one straight line; breathe.
instructions: Set the elbows under the shoulders and brace into one straight line.
Tuck the ribs, squeeze the glutes, and keep the hips level.
Breathe steadily without sagging or piking.
Hold for the target time, then lower under control.

name: Cable Crunch
cues: Kneel under a high cable; crunch the ribs to the pelvis; pause; control the return.
instructions: Kneel under a high cable with a rope held behind the head or at the shoulders.
Crunch the ribs toward the pelvis while keeping the hips mostly still.
Pause at the peak contraction.
Return under control without yanking with the arms.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Posterior tilt; knees to chest without swing; lower slow; quiet shoulders.
instructions: Hang from the bar with an active shoulder position.
Tilt the pelvis under and raise the knees toward the chest.
Avoid swinging and keep the shoulders quiet.
Lower the legs slowly and reset before the next rep.

name: Farmer Carry
cues: Tall posture; ribs down; short quick steps; crush the handles; walk the full distance.
instructions: Deadlift heavy dumbbells or implements to a standing lockout.
Brace tall with the ribs down and crush the handles.
Walk with short controlled steps for the target distance or time.
Set the weights down under control at the end of the carry.

name: Wrist Curl
cues: Forearms supported; full stretch to full flexion; light load; slow tempo.
instructions: Sit and rest the forearms on the thighs with the wrists hanging over the knees.
Curl the dumbbells through a full wrist flexion.
Lower into a full stretch at the bottom.
Use a light load and a slow tempo for clean reps.

name: Towel Pull-Up
cues: Drape towels over the bar; crush the grip; full hang to chin clear; control the lower.
instructions: Drape one or two towels over the bar and crush them in each hand.
Hang fully, then pull until the chin clears the bar.
Keep the grip locked and the body from swinging.
Lower under control to a full hang.

name: Cable Chest Fly
cues: Soft elbows; hug the arc; stretch at the open; squeeze at the close; no shoulder shrug.
instructions: Set dual cables at about chest height and step forward into a slight split stance.
With soft elbows, open the arms into a wide chest stretch.
Hug the handles together in a wide arc until they meet in front of the chest.
Keep the shoulders down and control both the open and close.

name: Step-Up
cues: Drive through the lead foot; stand tall on the box; control the descent; no push-off cheat.
instructions: Hold dumbbells and place one foot fully on a box or bench.
Drive through the lead foot to stand tall on the box.
Keep the torso upright and avoid shoving off hard with the trail leg.
Lower under control and finish the set before switching sides.
